sloka: द्विजाति वेषेण समीक्ष्य मैथिलीतम् आगतम् पात्र कुसुंभ धारिणम् ।अशक्यम् उद्द्वेष्टुम् उपाय दर्शनान्न्यमंत्रयत् ब्राह्मणवत् यथा आगतम् ॥३-४६-३५॥
transliteration: dvijāti veṣeṇa samīkṣya maithilītam āgatam pātra kusuṁbha dhāriṇam ।aśakyam uddveṣṭum upāya darśanānnyamaṁtrayat brāhmaṇavat yathā āgatam ॥3-46-35॥

translations.english: O brahmin, here is the seat for you. Feel free to sit. Here is water to wash your feet with. This is the best of food for you collected from the forest. Please partake this without hesitation.
